channelProvenance.albedo: de-lit reference crop, one per face; value-only normalisation (strength 0.6, radius 200px) with in-mask mean value restored
channelProvenance.roughness: authored per material zone + edge/spine polish + seeded grip speckle
channelProvenance.metalness: authored per material zone (binary metal vs polymer)
channelProvenance.ao: cavity erosion of the traced alpha mask
channelProvenance.normal: authored from measured anchors (quilt grid, ferrule beads, 4 screw dimples, lanyard chamfer)

uvOrientation: u = (worldX - xMin)/(xMax - xMin), v = (worldY - yMin)/(yMax - yMin), shared by every part so projected detail registers with geometry
note: albedo is never reused as roughness, metalness, normal or AO
